scenes.line: That link. That screenshot. That file called final, final, two. You saved them. Somewhere.
Meet Swiss. A pocket knife for your ideas.
It lives in your menu bar. Press Option Space, and it's right there.
Drop in links, pictures, files and notes. Copy something anywhere, and Swiss can keep it.
Every project gets its own tab. Folders, notes and links, living together like a very tidy family.
Total mess? Wave the wand. Poof. Sorted.
Need room to think? The Frame is a free canvas, floating above every app.
No account. No cloud. Everything stays on your Mac.
